tools.name: refresh_model_pricing
tools.description: Refresh provider pricing pages and separate OpenRouter/LiteLLM reference feeds, then recalculate dashboard estimates using provider-page rates only. Returns rate changes, source health, confidence, and current-versus-recorded dashboard totals. These are estimates, not invoice amounts.

tools.name: workflow_progress
tools.description: Report structured progress for a substantial multi-step task. Use only when the task has several dependent phases, likely spans turns, or needs explicit verification; skip simple tasks and work already covered by native tool progress. For agent-created workflows, send the full current items snapshot on every call and reuse the same workflow_id. Keep secrets and private data out of workflow fields.
